description: This file implements SQL store functions for managing subscriptions in the Focalboard server, including creating, deleting, fetching, and updating subscription records in the database.

methods.name: valuesForSubscription
methods.description: Converts a Subscription object into a slice of interface{} for database insertion.

methods.name: subscriptionsFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a slice of Subscription objects.

methods.name: createSubscription
methods.description: Creates a new subscription record or updates an existing one in the database.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Soft deletes a subscription by setting delete_at timestamp.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches a specific subscription for a block and subscriber.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a specific subscriber.

methods.name: getSubscribersForBlock
methods.description: Retrieves all subscribers for a specific block.

methods.name: getSubscribersCountForBlock
methods.description: Counts the number of subscribers for a specific block.

methods.name: updateSubscribersNotifiedAt
methods.description: Updates the notified_at timestamp for all subscribers of a block.
